releases.notes:
Playtest build for Minecraft 26.2. Put `from-stone-to-stars-0.11.0.jar` in your mods folder. The sources jar is the matching source and is not a mod to install.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API

JEI, Jade, WTHIT, Mod Menu, and YACL are optional.

## What's new since 0.10.0

- **Bore rig.** Set a drill head down with a rod rack on top, and an ore box and a drive housing on opposite sides. A shaft into the back of the drive housing turns it, and it costs one wheel slot. Forge two heated steel ingots (10 hits) into one steel drill rod. Use rods on the rack to load it. A rack holds 8 rods, and you can stack up to 8 racks. Hoppers can fill a rack. Each rod bores 8 blocks straight down. When the hole touches iron, copper, gold, coal, redstone, lapis, or zinc ore, the rig mines that whole vein, up to 64 blocks, into the ore box before it goes on. Diamond, emerald, and rusty mud stay in the ground. Lava stops the bore, and a full ore box waits. Use the drill head to read its status. Sneak-use with an empty hand recalls the string, fills the hole with stone, and brings most of the rods back. About one rod in four breaks. Sneak-use again to bore again. Use the ore box to open it. Sneak-use with an empty hand empties it, and hoppers can pull from it.
- **Drill head.** Two steel sheets, three steel ingots, two steel blades, a piston, and an iron tool head.
- **Drive housing.** Four steel sheets, two wooden gears, two steel ingots, and an iron block.
- **Ore box.** Four iron ingots, a steel sheet, and a wooden chest.
- **Rod rack.** Four iron ingots, a steel sheet, and two planks.
- **Look-at info.** Jade and WTHIT now share the same status for the forge, the ironworks fittings, the ore crusher, and the sawmill.
- **Small balances.** Flint and steel is crafted from a steel ingot and flint. Leather strips are cut from leather.

## What you can play

- Age 0, Primitive and Stone, is playable.
- Age 1, Zinc and Bronze, is playable. That includes bronze gear, the forge, forging, rotational power, and the sawmill.
- Age 2 has a route to iron, steel parts, the sawmill, the forge fittings, and the bore rig. The `age2` advancements are not built yet.

Balance, recipes, and save data may change between versions. Back up any world you care about.

Licensed under LGPL-3.0-only. Bug reports and test notes go in the issues tab.

Playtest build for Minecraft 26.2. Put `from-stone-to-stars-0.10.0.jar` in your mods folder. The sources jar is the matching source and is not a mod to install.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API

JEI, Jade, WTHIT, Mod Menu, and YACL are optional.

## What's new since 0.9.1

- **Forge fittings.** Steel fittings attach to the Age 1 forge, and each one works on its own.
- **Powered bellows.** A steel sheet, a bellows, and a wooden gear, stacked. It stands in the bellows bank, facing the hearth, with a shaft into the back. While it turns, the burn climbs to the coal-pad maximum and holds there. It costs one wheel slot. It does not relight a cold forge, and it can still be pumped by hand.
- **Steel-lined hearths.** Use a steel sheet on a hearth to line it. A lined hearth cooks as fast as two hearths. Breaking the hearth gives the sheet back.
- **Forge input.** Two steel sheets, a wooden chest, and five bricks. It replaces a frame cell beside the hearths and holds nine stacks. Hoppers can fill it from any side and cannot pull from it. A lit forge draws anything it can smelt or fire, taking from each input in turn.
- **Alloying from the inputs.** The forge runs crucible alloys straight from its inputs, one ingredient in each input, with no crucible. Four copper in one input and one zinc in another makes five bronze. Steel needs every hearth lined.
- **Tapping spout.** One steel sheet, a wooden chest, and seven bricks. It replaces a frame cell beside the hearths or the coal pad, facing away from the forge. Finished items and spent crucibles move into its nine stacks. It pushes one item at a time into the block it faces, and hoppers can pull from any side. Open it to take items out. You cannot put items in. Sneak-use with an empty hand empties it. Heated metal stays hot inside.
- **Ore crusher.** Two steel sheets, a wooden gear, and five iron ingots. It sits on a forge input with a shaft into the back, and it costs one wheel slot. While it turns, it crushes raw ore four times faster than a trip hammer and drops the crushed ore into the input below. It works whether or not the forge is lit.
- **Sawmill in JEI.** The sawmill, its parts, and its plank recipes now have their own JEI category.

## What you can play

- Age 0, Primitive and Stone, is playable.
- Age 1, Zinc and Bronze, is playable. That includes bronze gear, the forge, forging, rotational power, and the sawmill.
- Age 2 has a route to iron, steel sheets and blades, the sawmill, and the forge fittings above. The drill and the Age 2 advancement tree are not built yet.

Balance, recipes, and save data may change between versions. Back up any world you care about.

Licensed under LGPL-3.0-only. Bug reports and test notes go in the issues tab.

Playtest build for Minecraft 26.2. Put `from-stone-to-stars-0.9.1.jar` in your mods folder. The sources jar is the matching source and is not a mod to install.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.2
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API

JEI, Jade, WTHIT, Mod Menu, and YACL are optional.

## What's new since 0.8.0

- **Steel parts.** Heat a steel ingot, then forge two heated ingots (8 hits) into four steel sheets. A crafting hammer cuts a sheet into a steel blade. Four blades craft into steel saw blades.
- **Sawmill.** Build a saw arbor into a wall of steel saw blades, one to three lanes wide and two to three blades high, framed on the sides and top. Wooden rollers lead to log intakes on one end and plank outfeeds on the other. Extra intake and outfeed rows add storage. A water wheel turns the arbor, and each lane takes one wheel slot. A weak wheel runs one lane and a strong wheel runs two. While the mill is cutting, each lane turns one log into six planks, and a taller blade wall cuts a little faster. Logs and planks move along the rollers.
- A forging hammer used in crafting comes back one use more worn, and two hammers no longer combine in the crafting grid.

## What you can play

- Age 0, Primitive and Stone, is playable.
- Age 1, Zinc and Bronze, is playable. That includes bronze gear, the forge, forging, rotational power, and the sawmill.
- Age 2 has a route to iron, and steel can be forged into sheets, blades, and saw blades. The ironworks and the drill are not built yet.

Balance, recipes, and save data may change between versions. Back up any world you care about.

Licensed under LGPL-3.0-only. Bug reports and test notes go in the issues tab.
